judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the access decision in a single, readable expression, unconditionally appends a complete log record containing all three required fields (role, permission, allowed) before returning, and returns the boolean result. There is no branching that could bypass the log write, no unnecessary abstraction, no hidden state, and no architectural complexity. The deny-by-default behavior is correctly achieved via `matrix.get(role, set())`. The code is flat, explicit, locally auditable in under five seconds, and perfectly aligned with the Zen of Python.
